title: An imported name matching a deactivated term is saved as that term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 60 is deactivated.
  • Have a contacts import file with one new customer, customer A, whose credit term is "net 60".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads "Net 60 (Inactive)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-E1: “A name that matches a deactivated term is saved as that term; the customer then shows it as "{name} (Inactive)" (S5-R8).”
  • Key Decisions: “Imports and the Public API stay lenient. A blank term gets the default; a name matching any of the shop's terms (standard or its own, active or deactivated, ignoring capitals and spaces) is saved as that term in its correct spelling, and a deactivated one then shows as "{name} (Inactive)"; any other text is saved as sent and dated as today.”
  • S5-R8: “The customer card's "Credit term" shows "{name} (Inactive)" for a deactivated term. Invoices and printed documents show the plain name.”
